siteConfig.tone: Knowledgeable but approachable. Write like an experienced friend who works at a head shop, not an academic paper. Avoid corporate jargon.
siteConfig.voiceExample: Use 'we' and 'our' when referring to Oil Slick Pad. Example: 'We carry over 200 dab rigsâ¦'

titleTag.rule: Include the target keyword within the first 60 characters.

metaDescription.rule: Include target keyword naturally. End with a call to action ('Shop now,' 'Learn more,' 'Find yours').

urlHandle.rule: Lowercase, hyphenated, keyword-rich. Short, not stuffed.

headings.h1: One per post. Should contain or closely match the target keyword.
headings.h2: Use 3-6 per post. Include secondary keywords and long-tail variations.
headings.h3: Use for subsections within H2 blocks.

rules: Always link to the relevant collection page listed in the content calendar for that post.
Link to 2-5 specific product pages when mentioning or recommending products.
Link to related blog posts when relevant.
Use natural anchor text, not 'click here'.
Vary anchor text across posts linking to the same page.

contentQuality.wordCountRule: Follow the target for each post (1,500â2,500 words). Longer is not better if it's filler.
contentQuality.includeProductSpecs: When recommending products, include price, material, size, and key features.
contentQuality.comparisonTables: Include an HTML comparison table in every listicle and buying guide.
contentQuality.imageAltText: Every image must have descriptive alt text with the target keyword where natural.

publishing.tagsRule: Add 3-5 relevant tags matching product categories.
publishing.featuredImageRule: Every post needs a featured image. Ideally a product photo or lifestyle shot.
